newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Jan 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Jan 17.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

The criminal Investigation Department (CID) submitted charge sheet of the murder case of Father of the Nation Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman and his family members in the court of Chief Metropolitan Magistrate on Wednesday, according to official sources.
Jatiya party chief Lt.-Gen (retd) Ershad said that the Awami League will keep his party "alive" in its own interest and that the BNP will try to come closer.
The government yesterday constituted a hihg-power committee headed by the finance minister to take stock of the situation in the loss-incurring public sector jute and textile mills for a remedy.
Mosquitoes still continued to remain a major irritant for the city dwellers and a headache for the Dhaka City Corporation which seems to have neither any immediate nor a permanent remedy.
A committee of the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) invites dependable information from members of share markets to help it identify procedural complexities and also inquire into allegations.

Road communications between the eastern part and the 37 south and northern districts of the country have remained almost snapped for the fourth consecutive day on Thursday following heavy traffic jam at Aricha ghat.
The government at its highest level has finally decided to remove two members of the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), a quasi-judicial body regulating the country's capital market.
The groundbreaking ceremony of Korean Export Processing Zone, the country's first industrial park owned by a foreign private company, is expected to take place in April.
